items: Review replies suit AI well because they're text-based and follow a predictable format, and an AI tool stays consistent, diplomatic and available at any hour as review volume grows.
Choose a tool that reads each review's sentiment and drafts a personalized reply in your brand voice, and lets you approve replies or auto-publish them for the ratings you choose.
Look beyond individual replies: the most useful tools analyze all your reviews together to show which issues at which locations need attention first.
Momos' AI agent Alfie replies within minutes using each guest's history, can issue recovery offers through your loyalty and POS systems, and escalates to your team with full context.
